lines.text: It's Friday night. Time for the awards for everything you forgot this week.
Nominee one: your laundry. Still in the machine. Since Tuesday.
Nominee two: I'll call you back, Mum. That was Monday.
Nominee three: the parking meter. €40 ticket.
And the award for Most Forgetful goes to... you!
Relax. Your head isn't broken. It's just full.
So tonight, you text it all to Memopai on WhatsApp. It reminds you at the right time.
Next Friday? You're not even nominated.
Empty your head before the weekend. Just text Memopai on WhatsApp.
